description: Unofficial fan art of RX-78-2 Gundam from Mobile Suit Gundam, with simplified white armor, blue chest, red feet, yellow vents and a left-arm shield. Nine animations include alternating mechanical runs, head-sensor checks, an imagined chest maintenance panel, cloth-snag recovery, kneeling shield polishing and a jointed jump. Internal panel details and choreography are original adaptations; no official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
